verdict.rationale: FreeAgent documents OAuth 2.0 access and refresh tokens that let third-party apps reach a user's data without sharing login details. Nothing in the evidence shows scopes, permission restrictions, or least-privilege token issuance. Delegated OAuth access is an adjacent capability and does not show that credentials can be limited for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
